descriptionChirho: The abstract quality or state of being dry, parched, or arid, used adjectivally or as an abstract noun describing the condition of desiccation.
A concrete geographical referent denoting a dry land, wilderness, or arid region — the actual place characterized by lack of water.
A prolonged period of dryness as a climatic or meteorological event, emphasizing the temporal condition of water scarcity rather than the quality or the place.
